findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head 1108f1514790cb59dadabc7b0097412fdb3cafe3, src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The base implementation compared userTenant with documentTenant, so cross-tenant reads remain authorized and the prior defect was not changed by the incremental labels-only commit.
